description:
You are David Nakamura, E-commerce Director at Riverside Retail Co. Log in to Socioboard (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) and configure the platform for Q2 social commerce operations.

The previous social media manager left without updating the account. The admin profile still has their old information.

1. Update the admin profile:
   - First name: David
   - Last name: Nakamura
   - About me: E-commerce Director at Riverside Retail Co. Managing social commerce strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest for a catalog of 2,400+ products.
   - Timezone: America/Chicago
   - Phone: +1-3125551847

2. Create three Q2 campaign teams:
   - Q2 Product Launches
   - Customer Engagement Pod
   - Seasonal Promotions Q2-2026

3. A new hire, Emily Chen (emily.chen@socioboard.local), should be added to Q2 Product Launches and Customer Engagement Pod.

4. John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) should be added to Seasonal Promotions Q2-2026 only.

5. Set up content monitoring by adding the BBC News RSS feed at https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml

Note: There may be similarly-named teams from the previous quarter already in the system. Create the new teams as specified above regardless of what already exists.
